filters.title: product_name_fr OR (lang==fr AND product_name)
filters.description: generic_name_fr OR ingredients_text_fr OR (lang==fr AND generic_name/ingredients_text)
filters.category_tags: aliased through the curated rename map, then refused unless the id is a taxonomy node this catalog may file a product under; refused values are dropped, never their records
filters.category_path: hierarchical root->leaf path from OFF taxonomy (written for 223,036/223,036 records; 0 unresolved products dropped, 0 more dropped for a path that stops short of a taxonomy root)
filters.price: category baseline unit model + deterministic noise + label premiums + retail rounding
filters.dietary_restrictions: keyword list derived from labels_tags and ingredients_analysis_tags (positive-only)
